purpose: One validated visibility matrix for the nine full-coverage gates across all fifteen Taxlane analytical lanes.

status_meanings.missing: No evidence artifact currently closes the gate.
status_meanings.partial: Some source-backed or contract evidence exists, but the completion contract remains open.
status_meanings.complete: The gate has positive evidence for the full lane-specific completion contract.

gate_completion_contract.current_law_baseline: FY2025-FY2035 annual path from official sources, with component and fund treatment where relevant.
gate_completion_contract.source_custody: Source ID, publisher, URL, retrieval date, byte count or access boundary, SHA-256 when local bytes exist, and review status.
gate_completion_contract.public_explainer: Answers what it does, what taxpayers pay now, who is served or protected, outcomes, overspending/underfunding boundary, technology transition, evidence gaps, and blocked claims.
gate_completion_contract.outcome_floors: Threshold rationale, baseline values, policy values, stress values, and pass/fail evidence.
gate_completion_contract.policy_scenarios: Policy instrument, phase-in, behavior, transition/admin cost, incidence, score provenance, and floor results.
gate_completion_contract.transition_model: Implementation, training, cybersecurity/privacy/fallback where relevant, service-risk, stress, and measured productivity or explicit no-credit boundary.
gate_completion_contract.solver_mapping: Lane row mapping, fund treatment, interactions, null policy, and blocked outputs.
gate_completion_contract.receipt_rate_bridge: Legal/economic base, payer universe, distribution/incidence, administration burden, and current-law/reform yield.
gate_completion_contract.claim_boundary: Explicit allowed, blocked, and still-null claims.

plain_english_status: All fifteen analytical lanes have one validated coverage matrix with the nine required gates visible. Wave C completed public explainers, Wave D completed one source-custodied anchor per lane, and Wave E completed one role-reviewed current-policy reference calibration per lane. The Wave E packs verify central boundary passes and synthetic adverse failures but do not supply reform scenarios, federal effects, or lower-cost admissibility. Wave F records zero ready solver/rate prerequisites. Transportation is the deepest pilot, claim boundaries are explicit, and every lane remains incomplete for full coverage. No solver output, public rate, savings estimate, department cut, technology-savings claim, or balanced-budget claim is published.
